rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 24 formal hours: AMA PRA Category 1 (ACCME-accredited sponsor or ACCME-recognized state medical society), AAFP-approved, AOA Category 1-A, or TMA-approved per AMA PRA standards; up to 24 informal hours (self-study, hospital lectures, grand rounds, case conferences)
rules.alternatives: Presumed compliant (some requirements still apply, see TMB chart): ABMS/AOA board certification or recertification in the preceding 36 months (max one registration); participation in ABMS MOC or AOA OCC that mandates qualifying CME; residency/fellowship training within 6 months before renewal. Retired/voluntary charity care status is exempt.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Newly licensed physicians are exempt from the CME requirement at their first registration (targeted topics have their own first-renewal rules).
rules.carryover: Up to 48 excess credit hours may be carried forward, for up to two years from the registration following the period earned; ethics/professional responsibility and pain management/opioid hours cannot be carried forward.
rules.audit_note: Mandatory CE tracking via CE Broker for all TMB licensees from September 1, 2026; certificates are uploaded to CE Broker before renewal, not sent with the registration.

topics.who: All physicians: 2 of the 24 formal hours in medical ethics and/or professional responsibility (incl. risk management, domestic abuse, child abuse)
Physicians in direct patient care: formal CME in pain management and opioid prescribing within 1 year of license issuance and again at the second renewal, then every 8 years (every 4th renewal)
Physicians in direct patient care: HHSC-approved course in the first renewal period after licensure, then every third renewal period (every 6 years)
Physicians treating patients in an emergency room/urgent care setting; SASTF-approved course; starts with licenses expiring Feb 28, 2027 (HB 47)
Only personnel (incl. medical director) of certified pain management clinics, Board Rule 172.3

rules.notes: Single board for MD and DO. Also: 1 hr nutrition & metabolic health for all (licenses expiring on/after May 30, 2027); one-time free obstetric emergencies course (Life of the Mother Act, SB 31) for obstetric care; EMS medical directors 1 hr/renewal. Expiry: Feb 28, May 31, Aug 31, Nov 30.
